reason: I'd maybe sit down with them about the free QR payment, but I won't sign up for anything until I see the Keepz fee and payout time next to my bank terminal's. The loyalty and reviews part is nice, but my regulars already know me by name, and I don't sign up for a subscription now just because it's free for three months.
objection: They don't say the fee per transaction or when the money lands, which is the only thing I care about. If the money comes later than with my terminal or the fee is higher, the 29 lari is the smallest cost.
would_change_my_mind: A written fee lower than my terminal's with next-day payout, shown to me before I sign, and proof the 39 lari brings back guests worth more than that in one month.
